results_applied: indefinite physical-pair theorem with square-root small-ball remainder

partner_result_applied.scope_used: exact r39 estimate including its stated invariance under an affine z term

new_results.statement: For independent cap-one X1,X2,Z,W and |a|,|b|>=1, Q=2aX1X2+bZ^2+2kappa ZW has essential density cap 8*2^(1/4)|a|^(-3/4)|b|^(-1/4), uniformly in kappa. At kappa=0 this is exact rank three with (+,+,-) for b>0 and (+,-,-) for b<0.

Partner r39's rank-two-cross/internal-bilinear dyadic estimate is unchanged after adding 2*kappa*z*W+H(W) when W is independent of both active source banks. The resulting density is continuous by the same uniform L1 Fourier bound.

logarithmic_control: For centered unit uniforms p_{2aX1X2}(t)=|a|^{-1} log(|a|/(2|t|)); the genuine bZ^2 third direction removes this logarithm via its uniform sqrt-small-ball law. The residual kappa ZW term is absorbed by exact completion only after conditioning on a genuinely independent source variable.
sign_specific_splice: At the exact-rank-three kappa=0 endpoint, the pinned ruled theorem gives p_Q(s)<=pi*sqrt(2) on the majority-sign one-sheet side b*s>=0; the physical-pair theorem pays the full line including the opposite two-sheet side.
target_valid_example: Q_kappa=2ZX1+2X1Y1+2X2Y2+2kappa ZW has continuous density <13 uniformly in kappa and spectrum {+-1,+-s_+,+-s_-} with s_+>=sqrt(2), so it remains in the full target while s_->0.
next_step: Prove the r39 dyadic estimate uniformly for an added residual scalar W when (v,W) is one 3D projection of the same product bank, using full product-frame/X-ray provenance without conditioning on W; alternatively force an original-coordinate cut that places W on a disjoint source bank. Additional nonseparable spectrum remains separate.
scope_guard: Do not infer same-bank conditional caps, do not extend one-sheet X-ray control to the two-sheet side, and do not drop a small quadratic or cross term under rough unbounded laws.
